personalImageScope.limitation: Personal review is bounded source period, column, control and source-definition review supported by original-image replay and a third image reader. It is not a claim to have manually transcribed all 207,001 candidate observations or personally read all131complete pages.

findings: All65internally printed fiscal labels agree with the proposed actual reporting periods; catalogue and upload dates do not supply salary years.

All56selected named remuneration/expense controls agree with original painted source pixels. Six Interior TOTAL>75,000 labels omitted by context-v1 selector are recovered additively; literal rows did not change.

Northern and early Island introductory employee-count/occupation narratives occur above named tables on the same page; they are definitions and coverage controls, not additional named salary rows. Northern2011/12 literal headcount1034 agrees; Island2008/09 literal1890 agrees.

Remuneration and expenses are separate source columns. Interior2003/04 specifically labels TOTAL WAGES and TOTAL EXPENSES PAID. Printed expense-inclusive totals, lower-threshold aggregate payroll, employer benefit totals and board observations are not employee remuneration rows.

Northern2011/12 remuneration includes base salary, retroactive pay, taxable benefits, vacation payouts, retirement allowances, overtime and on-call premiums. Expenses include travel, tuition, registration, relocation and professional membership fees. Island2008/09 remuneration similarly includes base pay, retroactive pay, taxable benefits, vacation payouts and retiring allowances; travel/expenses include travel, conferences and professional memberships. These are payment disclosures, not annual salary rates.

Fraser2012/13 uses cash basis for disclosure and separately explains reconciliation to accrual financial statements. Its literal scope says equal to or greater than75000, with one named row below that amount retained. Threshold text is not authority to discard a printed named observation.
Actual VCH2012/13 numeric0.00expense cells remain zero. Expense dashes/blanks in other periods remain null. A subtotal does not impute missing fields.

Interior2003/04 literal named pay exceeds its printed control by95713.33, numerically equal to the printed HASSELBACK,PAUL pay onphysical6. This does not establish a cause, duplication or deletion authority; the independent actual row/field census must close and the residual must be published.

Island2023/24 literal expense residual is−45772 and pay residual+41. Island2022/23 literal8252rows differs from narrative8264; qualification must retain the unexplained twelve-observation difference. No balancing or invented rows.
All other nonzero residuals, including cents and whole-dollar differences, stay source-specific. Native agreements and matching controls are not independent identity verification.
Final acceptance remains conditional on complete native-reader/coverage audit,352distinct original-image exception targets and a pinned final manifest/provenance with these definitions/residuals.
